mood: joyful, light, lively, unless the real story supports another tone

motion.photos: a restrained custom scale from 1.02 to 1.08; the nonzero start prevents black frames on hard cuts; override only with evidence-grounded crop or movement intent

transitions.rule: Choose each boundary from its story motivation. A hard cut is valid when continuity, action, sound, or the beat calls for it; never add transition frames just to decorate.

opening: Open on the source-grounded hook, then reveal context.
closing: Land the promised payoff with the strongest relevant real shot.
